description: A contract that exists to exercise the macro.
It has one of everything the format can say, so that what the expansion does with each is a test rather than a claim.

types.name: OpenArgs
description: What it takes to open one thing.

fields.name: label
description: Required, so it is the one thing the constructor takes.

fields.name: settings
description: Passed through uninterpreted, which is what stops this shape carrying total equality.

fields.name: tags
description: Anything else to hang off it.

variants.name: gone_away
description: It is no longer there. Two words, so the spelling of the wire value is a test of the mapping.

types.name: Note
description: One item on the watch stream.

variants.name: done
description: Nothing more will follow. Carries no fields, so the constructor for it takes none.

types.name: Trouble
description: What went wrong, in a form a caller can branch on.

errors.name: demo
description: Something a producer of this contract could not do.

ops.name: demo.thing.watch
description: Watch one thing, until it stops.

ops.name: demo.thing.close
description: Close one thing. Answers nothing at all, which is a shape in its own right.
